title: go-dicom -events log, one line, version 1
description: One line of the log that the network commands append to with -events: a JSON object. The schema is for a line, not for the file. Readers ignore properties this schema does not name; a property added later does not make it a different version. Every line go-dicom writes now says schemaVersion 1; a line without one, as go-dicom 1.10.0 wrote, is version 1 too. See events.md.

event.description: What happened: the name of a network event, or STORED, the command's own line for an instance it kept.

time.description: When, in UTC, to the microsecond.

associationId.description: The association the line belongs to. Numbered from 1 in each process, so two processes writing to one file reuse the numbers. Absent from a line outside an association.

role.description: SCU on the side that requested the association, SCP on the side that accepted it.

localAE.description: The AE title of this side.

remoteAE.description: The AE title of the other side.

presentationContexts.description: The presentation contexts as proposed and as answered, on the lines that state the outcome of the negotiation.

error.description: The error that ended or failed what the line reports.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this line's format: 1, the one this schema describes. Written on every line, as the last property. Absent from a line of go-dicom 1.10.0, which is version 1. A reader treats a line with a version it does not know as one it cannot read.

pdu.description: A PDU as it crossed the connection. Which of the other properties are present depends on type.

typeCode.description: The first byte of the PDU (PS3.8 section 9.3).

length.description: The PDU's own length field: the bytes after its 6-byte header.

bytes.description: The PDU as it crossed the connection, in lower-case hexadecimal. When it was longer than -events-pdu-bytes, the start of it.

bytesTruncated.description: Present, and true, when bytes is only the start of the PDU.

maxPDULength.description: The largest PDU the sender of an A-ASSOCIATE-RQ or A-ASSOCIATE-AC will receive.

proposedContexts.description: The presentation contexts of an A-ASSOCIATE-RQ.

answeredContexts.description: The presentation contexts of an A-ASSOCIATE-AC.

source.description: Source of an A-ASSOCIATE-RJ or A-ABORT.

reason.description: Reason of an A-ASSOCIATE-RJ or A-ABORT.

pdvs.description: The presentation data values of a P-DATA-TF.

result.description: PS3.8 Table 9-18: 0 acceptance, 1 user-rejection, 2 no-reason, 3 abstract-syntax-not-supported, 4 transfer-syntaxes-not-supported.

command.description: True for a fragment of a command, false for one of a data set.

last.description: True for the last fragment of its message.

length.description: The bytes of the fragment, not counting its 2-byte header.

transferSyntax.description: The transfer syntax accepted, when the context was.

dimse.description: A DIMSE message, from its command set.

command.description: The command's name, such as C-STORE-RQ.

messageIdBeingRespondedTo.description: Message ID Being Responded To (0000,0120), on a response.

hasDataSet.description: Whether a data set follows the command.

stored.description: On a STORED line: an instance the command kept.
